programme.title: Superbeast S1E1 -Raw Power
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom’s most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E2 -Super Speed
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth’s fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Gladiators S1E3 -Jungle River
programme.desc: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

programme.title: Gladiators S1E4 -Tidelands
programme.desc: Head to America’s far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators S1E2 -Realm of the Wolf
programme.desc: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E5 -Shark Dynasty
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature’s most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Go Buster S1E1 -When Buster's Dreams Come to Life!
programme.desc: Join Buster as his amazing dreams come to life! First, he dreams he is a fish, complete with a tail & fins! He's scared when he meets a big shark, but soon learns the shark just wants a friend to play with. Then, it's all stations go as Buster dreams he's a space rocket & blasts off to tour all the planets! The dreams continue as he becomes Sheriff Buster in the wild west & finds a magic spell book that causes all sorts of trouble!

programme.title: Go Buster S3E2 -Learning How to Be a Good Friend!
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns how to be a good friend! When a new, shy student named Ash the firetruck joins the school, Buster sees he's all alone & invites him to play. Then, Buster learns another important lesson when he starts to lose a game of snakes & ladders & decides to cheat. From learning that sports aren't all about winning to standing up for his friends during a sleepover, Buster is on his way to being the best friend ever!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage S2E3 -Gecko & Red's Artsy August Day
programme.desc: Get creative in Gecko's Garage for Artsy August! Help Gecko fix Dylan's dumper and turn old parts into a fun slide. Then, join a messy car wash competition and help Red design a fabulous costume to steal the show at the carnival!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage S6E3 -Gecko's Artsy August Design Dash
programme.desc: Celebrate an Artsy August with Gecko! Join the recycling day race and help Gecko fix Mummy Truck’s tire. Then, bake a Thanksgiving pie with the Mechs, go on a space adventure, and take a fabulous, paint-splattered family photo!

programme.title: ARPO S3E1 -Mom's Crazy Inventions Go Haywire!
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo & Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum & they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride & Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO S2E1 -Squirrel Trouble & Other Wacky Problems!
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble & other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably & when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: Dance Party S1E2 -JJ Sings & Dances to Classic Rhymes!
programme.desc: It's a dance party featuring all your favorite classic rhymes! Join JJ, Bella & Cece as they dance to 'Hey Diddle Diddle' while the cow jumps over the moon. The fun continues as they help their friend Humpty Dumpty get home after a great fall with the help of some sea creature friends! Then, get ready to rock out with a band of monkeys in a brand-new version of 'Rockabye Baby.' From 'Five Little Speckled Frogs' to 'Looby Loo,' it's a dance party full of classic fun!

programme.title: CoComelon S3E1 -JJ's Yummy Food & Clean-Up Fun!
programme.desc: It's a day of yummy food & clean-up fun with JJ! First, learn about all types of pasta & make some from scratch in Grandma's kitchen. Then, Cody's Dad shows how fun & tasty healthy eating can be with delicious sliced fruit. After all the fun, it's time to clean up! JJ's family gives Bingo a scrub in the tub after he gets dirty playing outside, & all the kids chip in to wash a filthy firetruck. It's fun to make a mess, & even more fun to clean up!

programme.title: Dance Party S2E1 -Learn & Dance with JJ's Animal Pals!
programme.desc: It's a learning dance party with JJ's animal pals! First, learn all about vowels with the fun & silly song 'Apples & Bananas.' Then, get ready to count as you dance with dinosaurs & countdown from five to one. The learning continues as you guess what sounds different animals make & bounce like rabbits, frogs & kangaroos on a trampoline! Plus, you can even learn to sing 'Itsy Bitsy Spider' entirely in Spanish with Nina!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E9 -JJ's Favorite Songs & Stories!
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs & stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ & his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow & steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper & the Ants.

programme.title: Little Angel S4E13 -Baby John's Arts & Crafts
programme.desc: Get building this Artsy August! Help Baby John and Jacob use a building set to construct a playful bridge for a pet chameleon. Then, pretend to be cheeky monkeys on the playground and see Jill learn she is a princess just as she is!

programme.title: Little Angel S6E10 -Baby John's Artsy August Day
programme.desc: Let's get baking this Artsy August! Follow a picture cookbook with Baby John and Manny to make muffins, but get ready for a mess! Then, celebrate Dia de los Muertos, build toy boats, and have a fun, paint-splattering race in the garden!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S1E4 -Answering Big Questions!
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs & even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits & vegetables!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S1E1 -An Ultimate Animal Adventure!
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi & his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts & how ducks float. Blippi & FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm S1E1 -A Super Fun Day on the Farm!
programme.desc: Join Ella for a super fun day at Lellobee City Farm! First, when a nest of baby duck eggs starts to hatch, Ella has to play 'Mummy Duck' to keep all the cute but runaway ducklings together! Then, Rishi organizes all the animals for a friendly game of soccer, where everyone learns each other's animal sounds. The fun day ends with a new arrival, as Ella & Mei find & adopt a stray cat named Bingo, welcoming him to his new home!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm S1E2 -Healthy Habits & Happy You!
programme.desc: It's time to learn some healthy habits to keep you happy! First, Grandma Mei makes sure everyone washes their hands with lots of bubbles before eating some yummy dumplings. Then, when Baby Izzy doesn't want to eat her vegetables, Mei uses a bit of magic to make the veggies come to life to sing & dance! The healthy habits continue as the friends learn how to recycle trash to help save the planet & Ella learns to get right back up after getting a boo boo.

programme.title: Cody Time S2E4 -Cody's Artsy August Craft Corner
programme.desc: Get crafty this Artsy August! Help Cody’s family make a homemade alphabet when their soup is all gone. Then, play with an empty cardboard box, learn about African instruments, make a leaf crown, and form a rock band with your classmates!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E23 -YoYo's Artsy August Adventures
programme.desc: Get crafty this Artsy August! Learn to make a cool paper airplane with YoYo, step-by-step. Then, learn all about shapes, play a fun game of freeze dance with animal friends, and join a sports competition!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E22 -JJ's Artsy August Class
programme.desc: Get creative for Artsy August! Join Ms. Appleberry's class to learn how red, blue, and yellow Jello can mix to make purple, orange, and green. Then, transform toy cars with a splash of paint and learn how to tap dance to the beat!

programme.title: Cody Time S2E5 -JJ & Nina's Artsy August Dance Craze
programme.desc: Let's create a dance for Artsy August! Follow along as JJ, Mochi, and Kiki lead each other in fun new steps. Then, play Red-Light Green-Light, do a silly animal dance, pretend you're a graceful ballerina, and draw cool shapes with chalk!

programme.title: Morphle S6E3 -Orphle's Green Art-pocalypse!
programme.desc: Join an Artsy August chase! Orphle is causing chaos, splatting green paint everywhere. Help Mila and Morphle clean up his mess, rescue pets from the Bandits, and compete in a thrilling dinosaur triathlon. The creative chase is on!

programme.title: Morphle S2E5 -Morphle's Artsy August Attack!
programme.desc: Join an Artsy August adventure! Help Mila and Morphle repaint the city after Chroma steals its colors. Then, build a wild treehouse with magic pets, race in a dinosaur triathlon, and win the big Petport Rally!

programme.title: Minibods S1E5 -An Adventure, Pedals, Rescue & Stars!
programme.desc: Join the Minibods for an adventure with pedals, rescues & stars! Lulu goes camping but realizes she's left her favorite Binky Bunny behind & has to learn how to cope. Then, Newt goes on an adventure to find a real-life Flutterbug, but she has to be brave when her bike's stabilizers come off! The adventures continue as Jeff overcomes his fear of mud to rescue his feather duster & Bubbles builds a rocket to try & reach a big purple star in the sky!

programme.title: Minibods S1E3 -A Sick Trick, A Spider, A Bump & A Fly!
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a sick trick, a spider, a bump & a fly! First, Jeff is sick, but after he recovers, he misses the attention & pretends he's still unwell! Then, Fuse is woken up by spooky noises in the night & must put on a brave face for Lulu to investigate. His bravery is tested again when he finds a spider in his gym & doesn't know how to get it out. The chaos ends when Pogo can't sleep & has to deal with a very noisy fly!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum S10E1 -Stan's Artsy August
programme.desc: Join an Artsy August dress-up party! Pretend to be anything you can imagine. Dive under the sea to count colorful fish, make yummy pancakes in different shapes, and cheer on Mia as she learns to ride her two-wheel bike!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum S3E3 -A Big Playtime Sing-Along!
